metadata.title: रेल पटरी पर आदिवासी जीवन की साईकल | How tribals balance life on a rail track in Jungle
metadata.description: There is only one railway line which connects Agartala (Tripura) to rest of the country. This railway line crosses through hills of West Tripura, where lives Rupini tribe. The people of this tribe have never travelled in the train which crosses there village every day, still the railway line is very useful for them. To know the full story watch this very special episode of Main Bhi Bharat.
